groups.sentence: Students do not submit AI-generated content as their own work without disclosing or citing the AI use.
Students are honest about their AI use when asked to disclose it.
Using AI without disclosure, citation or acknowledgment is an academic integrity or honor code violation.
Failing to cite or acknowledge AI use is treated as plagiarism or cheating.
Undisclosed or uncited AI use carries penalties, such as a failing grade or disciplinary action.
Instructors set documentation and disclosure requirements; work that does not follow them is treated as an attestation of no AI use or a violation.
Disclosing AI use does not shield students from misconduct findings, since the use may still be misuse or a violation.
Disclosed, permitted AI use is not penalized or graded differently, and disclosure protects students from suspicion.
